name: Yazuki Miyu
source:
Although her timid personality and frail physique wouldn't suggest this, Miyu is the representative of Mitsuki's class. Miyu is proficient at cooking and a member of the school's Cooking Club. Due to her nature, she often ends up overworking herself. She gets on well with [url=/c1550]Asahi[/url].
Miyu enjoys collecting all sorts of curios, like ornamented teacups and spoons.
